description: This PHP script handles the saving and access control for the Security Group-User relationship in the SuiteCRM module. It verifies user permissions, updates relationship fields based on submitted form data, and redirects after saving.

classes.name: SecurityGroupUserRelationship
classes.description: Model class representing the relationship between security groups and users, with properties like 'id', 'user_id', 'securitygroup_id', 'noninheritable', and 'primary_group'.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Persists the current SecurityGroupUserRelationship object to the database.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Loads the relationship record identified by the provided ID into the object.
